I first became aware of When Hounds Fly years ago when I was running a dog-walking business. At the time, there wasn't much in the neighbourhood that was strictly positive reinforcement–based.

A few months after When Hounds Fly opened, something genuinely noticeable happened: more and more dog owners in the area were using positive training methods. You could see it in the dogs. That shift didn’t just change the culture — it made my job easier. I was increasingly inheriting dog-walking clients who already had a solid foundation in R+, instead of dogs dealing with the fallout of harsh training.

Fast forward 16 years, and now I have a puppy of my own — and finally the opportunity to take classes myself. The experience has exceeded expectations.

The When Hounds Fly UX is excellent. Everything flows smoothly, and the online community for enrolled students is outstanding. Every exercise you learn in class is documented there, including short videos, so you’re never expected to remember every tiny detail. Miss something? No problem — you can revisit the instructions anytime.

Customer service has been exceptional from day one. Every single interaction has been thoughtful, responsive, and supportive. The instructors are fantastic — clear, compassionate, and deeply knowledgeable. And the fact that you can join free Zoom sessions with an instructor if you need extra help or have questions is honestly above and beyond.

This is thoughtful, modern, ethical dog training done right — and it shows not just in the classroom, but in the community it creates. And you can tell how much they want you and your dog to succeed.

I can’t say enough good things about When Hounds Fly. We have been taking our puppy there since we got her when she was just 8 weeks old, and the classes have been invaluable. The Puppy Start Right and Puppy Socials were extremely helpful and really helped our dog become confident and social while also giving us a lot of important insights into how to care for a dog and how to make sure that you set them up for success. We’ve now moved on to adult and trick classes and I am still consistently impressed by the professionalism and skill that the instructors all demonstrate. They give clear and easy to follow lessons and do an amazing job of remembering every dog’s name and their individual quirks and behaviours so that every class also feels like a personalized lesson. Just try not to get jealous because I think our dog loves Ethan (pictured below) and Luca almost as much as they love us! When we approach the building she gets as excited as she does when she is about to be fed or is going to the dog park, that’s just how much she loves her classes and her amazing instructors. When Hounds Fly will even help you get a better understanding of how your dog thinks and learns so in addition to the important skills and tricks your dog learns you will also become a better and more capable dog owner.

Every instructor that we have had has been incredible, but I want to give special shoutouts to Ethan and Luca. They are both incredibly good at taking complicated and sometimes impossible looking dog skills and then breaking it down into simple and easy to follow steps. It has been extremely satisfying to apply these lessons and to see how much our dog improves both during and in between classes. It turns out that the lessons aren’t just for dogs, you will also learn a lot about how your dog thinks and acts and will become a much better dog owner as a result.
